meaning: Source-derived hypotheses: ideas from the teachers Madhav learned from (and from his own trades). None is an Ananta rule until a pre-registered repair-shop test supports it. Market for every test: crypto spot, our 10 coins, NDAX costs.

status_words.UNVERIFIED: a teacher's claim; nothing measured on our coins yet
status_words.FIRST_LOOK: run once on our coins with the teacher's own parameters (not a validation)
status_words.PROMISING: first look positive in both periods; goes to the repair shop
status_words.NOT_SUPPORTED: first look negative or no better than random; not used
status_words.INSUFFICIENT: tested; too few cases to say
status_words.POLICY: a safety principle Madhav chose to apply now (not a market claim)

first_look_method: src/research/teacher_systems.py: daily/weekly bars from our 5m data, stated parameters only, BTC as the index, 0.20% fee + coin half-spread each side, DISCOVERY 2017-2023 vs CONFIRM 2024-Jul 2026 (holdout never loaded), each coin its own 10% slot; 'random' = same coin, same holding time, random start.

hypotheses.claim: Only buy when the market is in an uptrend (index above its 50/200-day average); cut size hard when it is below both.
sources: TWT: How to Use a BEAR MARKET to Build Wealth
TWT: Why I remain Bullish during Stock Market Correction (cut size 75-90% below 50 and 200 DMA)
Rayner: 200 MA bias in most strategies
hypotheses.variable: BTC daily close vs its 50-day and 200-day averages
hypotheses.evidence: Ananta's own V02 (BTC above its 50-day average) is KEEP: T2/T3 beat buy-and-hold on drawdown in both periods; LUNA crash 0% vs -56%. Review #7 (zones): support zones held 68% with BTC above its 50-day vs 50% below (2018-23), +3.7% vs -1.2% over 10 days; weaker since 2024 (57% vs 55%).
hypotheses.used_as: REGIME gate in the decision chain

hypotheses.claim: Only buy coins whose own trend is up (price above a rising 50-day average; stage 2).
sources: TWT: STAN WEINSTEIN Trading Method (weekly 50-period MA)
TWT: Stage analysis videos (30-week MA)
Rayner: trend first, then area of value
hypotheses.variable: coin daily close vs 20/50-day averages; 50-day slope
hypotheses.evidence: Ananta's own V01 is KEEP (portfolio layer T3 halves drawdown vs buy-and-hold).

hypotheses.claim: Stage 2 breakouts (weekly close above a rising 30-week average, above 26-week resistance, on 2x volume, relative strength vs the index rising) are the best long trades.
sources: TWT: STAN WEINSTEIN Trading Method
TWT: Stage Analysis - Genius Of Stan Weinstein (members only)
hypotheses.evidence: First look as a stand-alone system: 2017-2023 16 trades, 50% won, avg +330% (but below buy-and-hold and about random-like); 2024-Jul 2026 10 trades, 1 won, avg -19% vs random same-hold +11%. The 50-week version (TWT) the same: 9 trades, 1 won, avg -20%. As a regime label (not a buy signal) it is untested.
hypotheses.next: Test 'stage' as a regime feature for other setups, not as an entry.

hypotheses.claim: Buy weekly closes above the 50-week high, sell below the 40-week low, only when the index is above its 100-week average (+5,024% on US stocks).
sources: Rayner: SIMPLE Trading System: +5,024% (Backed By Data)
hypotheses.evidence: First look: 2017-2023 16 trades, 62% won, avg +152% vs random same-hold +435%; 2024-Jul 2026 6 trades, none won, avg -43%. Crypto swings are too wide for a 40-week-low exit.
hypotheses.next: Only as a trailing idea with faster exits (ATR or 20-week), if at all.

hypotheses.claim: Buy closes above the 200-day Bollinger band at +4 SD, sell below -0.5 SD, index above its 300-day average.
sources: Rayner: I Backtested This Bollinger Band Strategy 325 Times...
hypotheses.evidence: First look: 2017-2023 19 trades avg +267% (one +4,021% outlier); 2024-Jul 2026 9 trades, 1 won, avg -7.9% vs random +7.6%.

hypotheses.claim: In an uptrend (above the 200-day average), buy a sharp dip (close below the 20-day band at -2.5 SD) with a limit 3% lower; sell when RSI(2) closes above 50 or after 10 days.
sources: Rayner: Mean Reversion System That Works (Backed By Data)
Rayner: Bollinger Band Pullback System (+2834%)
Rayner: This Bollinger Band Trading System Has Generated 1689%
hypotheses.evidence: First look: 2017-2023 30 trades, 77% won, avg +4.5% per trade after costs vs random same-hold +0.35%; 2024-Jul 2026 20 trades, 60% won, avg +0.6% vs random -0.9%. Positive and above random in both periods, but only 50 trades. Matches Madhav's own instinct (buy weakness inside an uptrend) and repair-shop review 3. Review #11: the zone version (a dip into the 50-day zone in an uptrend) was worse than an average day under the same conditions (-3.8% over 20 days, 2018-23); the original deep-Bollinger form keeps its first-look status.
hypotheses.next: Repair-shop question: pre-register on daily bars for 10 coins + the fresh 10, count variants (band 2.0/2.5, limit 0/3%).

hypotheses.claim: Above the 200-day average, buy when RSI(10) drops below 30; sell when it crosses back above 40 or after 10 days (88.89% win rate, 36 trades on the S&P 500).
sources: Rayner: This SIMPLE Trading Strategy Has A 88.89% Winning Rate
hypotheses.evidence: Same family as H06. Review #13: with its own exit (RSI back over 40 or 10 days) +4.1% per trade, 70% won (2018-23) and +4.2%, 68% (2024-26); held 20 days it was worse than an average uptrend day (-7.1%). The same-exit baseline test is next. Review #14: against ordinary uptrend days traded with the same exit, +3.9% per trade (z 2.3, 25 market events) in 2018-23 and +5.6% (z 2.8, 16 events) since 2024: the most consistent result so far, 5 events short of the bar. Review #15 (lake, 2026-10-04): reproduced exactly on LAB10; PASS on the 30 most-traded coins (33 events, +6.0%, z 3.5; confirm +3.6%, z 3.2); FAIL on all 120 (discovery z 1.77 on 48 events, confirm +4.8%, z 4.6). Works on liquid coins, not on the long tail; what a TOP30-only pass earns is Madhav's call.

hypotheses.claim: Buy what outperforms its benchmark: price and the relative-strength line (asset / index) both making higher highs; RS often turns before price.
sources: TWT: How To Pick Stocks For Beginners Using Relative Strength Analysis (parts 1-3)
TWT: FALSE BREAKOUT 3 RULES (RS must be rising)
TWT: STAN WEINSTEIN Trading Method
hypotheses.variable: coin / BTC ratio: 30-day change and vs its 50-day average
hypotheses.evidence: Casebook C2 (June 25): SOL held above its June 5 low while BTC made a new 52-week low; SOL then rose 28% in a week. One case. Review #7: at support zones, being stronger than BTC over 30 days did not make the zone hold more often (59% vs 59%, 2018-23; same since 2024). Untested for breakouts.
hypotheses.used_as: observation in the decision chain (not a gate)

hypotheses.claim: Breakouts on expanding volume (well above the recent average, ideally the highest in 2-3 months) fail less.
sources: TWT: FALSE BREAKOUT in PRICE ACTION Trading (3 RULES)
TWT: STOCK SELECTION STRATEGIES
TWT: How To GROW Trading Account (VCP: volume above the prior 20 days)
hypotheses.variable: relative volume at the breakout bar
hypotheses.evidence: Explorer E2 already requires 1h volume >= 1.5x; E2 vs no-volume breakouts can be compared from the Explorer log. Review #7: at support zones, a 1.5x volume day did not help (55% vs 60% held). Untested for breakouts, where the claim applies. Review #11 (breakouts, where the claim applies): closes through a zone on 1.5x volume beat the same-condition average in both periods (+5.2%, +6.1% over 20 days) but not reliably (z 0.9, 1.3).
hypotheses.used_as: observation in the decision chain: present / absent / conflicting / unavailable

hypotheses.claim: Tight consolidation with falling volatility and volume (VCP, build-up, coil) before a breakout gives better breakouts; buy near the top of the base, stop below it.
sources: Rayner: Breakout with build-up (several videos)
TWT: VCP / cup and handle / coil-spring videos
TWT: Swing trading with Heiken Ashi (coil-spring)
hypotheses.variable: days in base, base width, volume and range vs before, higher lows inside
hypotheses.evidence: Casebook C3 (Aug 10): 33 days stuck between about 100-109 CAD, volume 0.53x and ranges 0.56x of before, higher lows; broke up 9 days later, +29.5% in 30 days. One case. Tested as Madhav's quiet-base read (reviews #5, #8) and as base floors (review #6): not supported on our coins.

hypotheses.claim: In a healthy uptrend, buy pullbacks to the rising 50-day average (20-day in strong trends, 200-day in weak ones); do not chase price 8-10% above the 50-day.
sources: Rayner: Do You Make This Pullback Trading Mistake?
Rayner: The Only Moving Average Strategy You'll Ever Need
TWT: 10 Charts To Help You Understand The Markets (8-10% extension rule)
hypotheses.variable: distance from the 20/50-day averages in ATRs
hypotheses.evidence: Explorer E1 is the 1-hour version (lost after costs in the 7-year replay); the daily version is untested. Review #11: a dip into the 50-day zone in an uptrend did worse than an average uptrend day (-3.8% over 20 days, 2018-23; +1.5% since 2024): not supported on our coins.
hypotheses.used_as: no longer used: the chain's LOCATION gate now asks for a zone history supports (Madhav, 2026-10-03)

hypotheses.claim: After a breakout, wait for the first shallow pullback (the 20-period average catches up), buy above its high.
sources: Rayner: 3 Best Price Action Strategies I've Learned Over 10 Years
Rayner: Sniper Trading Entries
Rayner: Price Action: 4 Golden Rules
hypotheses.evidence: Review #13: +4.3% over the same-condition average in 2018-23 (z 1.1), 0.0% since 2024: not supported.

hypotheses.claim: A break below an obvious level that closes back above it (trapped sellers) is a low-risk long; at a 52-week or multi-year low it is only a short counter-trend bounce.
sources: Rayner: How To Avoid False Breakout And Profit From Trapped Traders (reversal candle >= 1.5 ATR)
Rayner: How To Trade Counter Trend Trades Safely
hypotheses.variable: false break of a swing low / 52-week low
hypotheses.evidence: Casebook C1 (June 5): SOL made a new 52-week low on capitulation volume and bottomed 4.5% lower the next day. One case. Review #13: a reclaim of a support zone added +0.9% / +1.4% over an average market-allowed day (z 0.3): not supported.

hypotheses.claim: Put the stop about 1 ATR beyond the structure, not at it and not at a fixed percent.
sources: Rayner: Stop Loss Strategy Secrets
Rayner: ATR Indicator Secrets
Rayner: How to Set a Stop loss in Trading
hypotheses.variable: stop buffer in ATRs beyond the swing low
hypotheses.evidence: Casebook: Ananta's ~2% stops were shaken out in the same dips Madhav's structural stops survived (C1 -4.5%, C3 -5.2%).
hypotheses.used_as: INVALIDATION gate (structure below price, 1 daily ATR buffer)

hypotheses.claim: Ride trends with a trailing stop (3x ATR medium-term, 5-6x ATR long-term, or a close below the 20/50-day average) instead of fixed targets.
sources: Rayner: 5 Trailing Stop Loss Techniques
Rayner: Average True Range Indicator Strategies
Rayner: A Simple Trend Following Strategy (6 ATR chandelier)
hypotheses.evidence: Review #12: as T3's exit, a 3-ATR chandelier tripled 2018-23 returns but lost 22% in 2024-Jul 2026 (T3: +13%); MAR worse in the confirm period: not supported.

hypotheses.claim: A real recovery needs breadth: most of the market above its 50/200-day averages and making higher highs; bear-market rallies are narrow.
sources: TWT: Is the Stock Market Rally for Real?
TWT: How Strong Is This Market Bottom? (4-15 day rule)
TWT: A SIMPLE Weekend Checklist
hypotheses.variable: share of our coins (and the fresh 10) above their 50/200-day averages
hypotheses.evidence: Review #13: with the market allowed, strong breadth was followed by +15.5% vs +4.9% over 20 days (2018-23, z 1.6) but only 24 vs 22 independent samples; +1.5% vs -0.2% since 2024.

hypotheses.claim: Do not buy everything at the breakout: start with about 25%, add the rest after a pullback holds and a strong candle confirms.
sources: TWT: THIS POSITION SIZING TIP CHANGED MY LIFE (PYRAMIDING)
hypotheses.variable: staged entry vs all-in on the same signals
hypotheses.evidence: Madhav built his SOL position in steps (87.67, 91.6, 97.95, then 109 as a separate trading lot).

hypotheses.claim: Market-wide fear is often the opportunity; bad news about the asset itself is the trap.
sources: TWT: 'amazing opportunities coincide with horrible news'
Madhav's Yes Bank lesson (docs/casebook/cases.json L1)
hypotheses.variable: point-in-time news verdict (asset damage / supply / market fear / good)
hypotheses.evidence: News check (src/research/news_check.py): his 4 SOL buys CAUTION/CLEAR, Yes Bank Sep 2018 and Mar 2020 BLOCK. Six cases.

hypotheses.claim: Risk a small fixed share of the account per trade (0.5-1%); size = risk / stop distance; smaller size when volatility is high.
sources: Rayner: Stock Risk Management: How To Calculate Your Position Size
TWT: R Multiple; Risk of ruin
hypotheses.evidence: Applied now in the decision chain's RISK gate (1% of the paper account; stop farther than 15% = cannot size sensibly). The exact percent stays a hypothesis.

hypotheses.claim: Correlated positions are one bet: alts that move with BTC share one exposure budget.
sources: Madhav's framework notes 2026-10-03
Rayner: trade uncorrelated markets
TWT: basket-level stop
hypotheses.evidence: Applied now in the decision chain's EXPOSURE gate (at most 5 open BTC-correlated longs).

hypotheses.claim: Cut everything when open losses on the whole book reach about 7-8%.
sources: TWT: THIS POSITION SIZING TIP CHANGED MY LIFE (PYRAMIDING)
TWT: hard 7% portfolio stop
hypotheses.evidence: Ananta's circuit breaker is specced (4-5 straight losses -> pause); a book-level loss cut is not built. Review #13: an 8% book stop on T3 sold after dips T3 rides out (48 stops); MAR 1.19 vs 1.57 (2018-23), 0.11 vs 0.12 (2024-26).
